wolfram.note: Dimensions(Array(a, {2,1,4,3})) returns an empty Tuple instead of {2,1,4,3} -- Array with an explicit literal dims list should be able to answer Dimensions directly from the dims argument without constructing the full array; a real, scoped structural-inference gap.

Wolfram's Dimensions reads any expression as an array of its arguments: Dimensions[Power[2, 1/2]] and an unevaluated two-argument call are {2}. Ours takes a scalar or an unevaluated call as having no dimensions. A convention, not a bug.
